title: Law requiring fireproof battery boxes for delivery e-bike riders
summary: This bill would require businesses that use bicycles for commercial purposes to give their delivery riders a fireproof or fire-resistant container for charging removable e-bike batteries, when charging does not happen entirely at the business. The requirement applies only to motor-assisted bicycles with removable batteries, and businesses could not make riders pay for the containers themselves. The Fire Department would set rules for what counts as fireproof or fire-resistant, and the law would take effect 120 days after passage.
